preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 24 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: a is a list of n positive integers, each at most 10^9.
k is an integer between 0 and 2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(bad) == k and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in bad)
preconditions.description: bad is a list of k positive integers, each at most 10^9.
The sum of elements in a equals d, the destination point.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (sum(1 for p in permutations(range(n)) if all(sum(a[p[i]] for i in range(j+1)) not in bad for j in range(n))) % 1000000007
postconditions.description: The output equals the count of permutations of indices such that no prefix sum of the permuted array a matches any value in bad, modulo 10^9 + 7.
